proposedEditorialSelection.method: Rank each admitted current-week report by consequential change, reach, reader impact, evidence quality and recency. Multiple themes may coexist; a Weekly should map the week rather than force all reports into one thesis.

rankedRecords.basis: NVIDIA announced an agreement September 3 to acquire Hugging Face for $12.9303bn. Its announcement says Hugging Face will remain open and NVIDIA compute will not be required; treat these as commitments in an announced transaction, not verified completed-policy outcomes.
A newly released high-capability model changes available work across apps; the record includes vendor, system-card and external-evaluator sources.
A second major model release with stated capability, cost, availability and safeguard changes; it affects readers choosing models for demanding work.

Google’s official September 2 release note states Gemini 3.8 Flash is generally available for long-horizon software engineering, autonomous agents, and complex enterprise workflows. Treat as a developer/API release; no unverified consumer availability, price, regional or benchmark claim.
A government filing in active litigation has broad downstream consequences, while the existing report keeps the distinction from a court ruling explicit.
A peer-reviewed prediction study is consequential because medical use is high stakes; the existing report preserves the evidence-to-care gap.

OpenAI’s September 1 announcement states that authorized Epic EHR context and a read-only Healthcare Public Data plugin are available in ChatGPT for Healthcare under stated organizational controls. Treat as a healthcare organization product development, not consumer availability or clinical-outcome proof.
A current, concrete safety-relevant development with primary investigation material and a narrow reader consequence.
Reported global advertising expansion and conversation-context use create a direct trust and personalization question for a large audience.

proposedEditorialSelection.intendedTreatment: Nine developments meet the actual August 31–September 6 source/event window. Give the announced NVIDIA–Hugging Face acquisition, three model releases, legal filing, and health developments proportional treatment; retain the wiki and advertising changes as shorter evidence-rich reporting. The July 30 cybersecurity report and August 30 OpenClaw release remain excluded for period integrity.
proposedEditorialSelection.selectionLimit: Ranking existing admitted Daily reports does not establish that the week was exhaustively covered or that every ranked item belongs in the final prose.
